def remove_nipsa_action(index, annotation):
    """Return an Elasticsearch action to remove NIPSA from the annotation."""
    source = annotation["_source"].copy()
    source.pop("nipsa", None)
    return {
        "_op_type": "index",
        "_index": index,
        "_type": "annotation",
        "_id": annotation["_id"],
        "_source": source,
    }
